note: Phone Number defines a 'phone_number' field type (columns value [E.164], country, local_number, extension), default widget phone_number_default, default formatter phone_number_international (also phone_number_local, phone_number_country), and a PhoneNumber validation constraint backed by giggsey/libphonenumber-for-php. Field settings: allowed_countries, allowed_types, extension_field; storage setting: unique; widget settings: default_country, country_selection, placeholder, phone_size. All parsing/formatting is in the phone_number.util service. No admin settings page (configure=null) - configured per field. Medium/hard cases create real phone_number fields on the Article content type (namespaced field_pn_*) and inspect/verify the live field config; each reset/cleanup deletes only its own field storage+instance (never an unscoped field purge).

evals.prompt: What field type does the phone_number module provide, what does it store, and what are its default widget and formatter?
evals.expected_output: It provides the 'phone_number' field type, storing four columns: value (E.164 number), country (ISO code), local_number, and an optional extension. Default widget is phone_number_default and default formatter is phone_number_international; a PhoneNumber validation constraint validates input via libphonenumber.

evals.prompt: Which settings let me restrict a phone_number field to certain countries, require uniqueness, set a default country, and show it as a clickable tel: link?
evals.expected_output: Field setting allowed_countries restricts allowed countries (allowed_types restricts number types); storage setting unique enforces uniqueness; widget setting default_country sets the default country (with country_selection, placeholder, phone_size); the international/local formatters have an as_link setting to render a tel: link.

evals.prompt: How can I validate or format a phone number programmatically with the phone_number module?
evals.expected_output: Use the phone_number.util service (PhoneNumberUtilInterface), which wraps giggsey/libphonenumber-for-php. testPhoneNumber() validates (throwing CountryException/ParseException/TypeException on invalid input), getCallableNumber() returns the E.164 number, getRfc3966Uri() the tel: URI, and getCountryOptions()/getTypeOptions() list countries/types.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a phone_number field named field_pn_known that is restricted to certain countries. Inspect the live field configuration and list which countries are allowed.
evals.expected_output: field_pn_known (type phone_number) on node.article has field settings allowed_countries = ['US', 'GB'], so only US and GB numbers are allowed.

evals.prompt: Does the phone_number field field_pn_uniq on the Article content type enforce that a phone number can only be used once? Inspect the live field storage configuration and give the value of the relevant setting.
evals.expected_output: Yes: the field storage field_pn_uniq has setting unique = 1 (PHONE_NUMBER_UNIQUE_YES), so the phone number must be unique across entities.

evals.prompt: On this site, add a Phone Number field named field_pn_task to the Article content type (using the phone_number module's field type), and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a FieldStorageConfig field_pn_task on node with type 'phone_number', and a FieldConfig for the article bundle. Verified by node.article having a field field_pn_task whose type is phone_number.

evals.prompt: I need a phone number field on my Articles that only accepts United States phone numbers. Add it (call it field_pn_us) using the Phone Number module and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a phone_number field field_pn_us on node.article with field settings allowed_countries = ['US']. Verified by the field existing with type phone_number and allowed_countries containing only US.
